answer: Persistent Attention Ledger. Each identity must maintain a public stream of answered micro-queries at unpredictable intervals; a missed window decays its weight like a river eroding a bank. Sybils must staff every fake identity around the clock, so an attacker pays continuous human or compute attention rather than a one-time fee. A rare comet of inactivity resets the ledger, and only crystal-clear response timing restores standing.
